st%20in%20popular%20culture%2C%20and%20has%20written%20about%20Toy%20Story%20and%20Westerns%2C%20among%20other%20facets%20of%20American%20life.%20His%20major%20theoretical%20work%2C%20however%2C%20is%20on%20Thing%20theory%2C%20which%20borrows%20from%20Heidegger%27s%20object%2Fthing%20distinction%20to%20look%20at%20the%20role%20of%20objects%20that%20have%20become%20manifest%20in%20a%20way%20that%20sets%20them%20apart%20from%20the%20world%20in%20which%20they%20exist.%20He%20edited%20a%20special%20issue%20of%20Critical%20Inquiry%20on%20this%20subject%2C%20which%20won%20the%20CELJ%20award%20for%20Best%20Special%20Issue%20of%20an%20academic%20journal%20in%202002.%20His%20essay%2C%20%22The%20Dark%20Wood%20of%20Postmodernity%3A%20Space%2C%20Faith%2C%20Allegory%2C%22%20which%20treats%20religious%20themes%20in%20the%20work%20of%20Marxian%20cultural%20theorist%20Frederic%20Jameson%20and%20in%20postmodern%20culture%20generally%2C%20was%20awarded%20the%20Modern%20Language%20Association%27s%20William%20Riley%20Parker%20Prize%20in%202005.Brown%20has%20a%20B.A.%20from%20Duke%20University%2C%20an%20M.A.%20in%20Creative%20Writing%20(poetry)%20from%20Stanford%20University%2C%20and%20a%20Ph.D.%20from%20Stanford%20University%27s%20Modern%20Thought%20and%20Literature%20program.%20He%20has%20been%20teaching%20at%20the%20University%20of%20Chicago%20since%201989.%22%40en#1"},
